metal_fabrication_process.label: Metal-fabrication process
metal_fabrication_process.value: Factory pre-insulation and jacketing, hot-applied anti-corrosion coating on steel casing, and filament-wound fiberglass cladding on steel conduit.

precision_tolerance_requirement.label: Precision / tolerance requirement
precision_tolerance_requirement.value: Gap-free insulation, centered service pipe within the conduit casing, and small conduit seams for complete cladding adhesion.

custom_standardized_component_mix.label: Custom / standardized component mix
custom_standardized_component_mix.value: Project-engineered pre-insulated piping and custom containment systems, alongside standard-length PVC-THERM pipe sections.

tooling_equipment_capability.label: Tooling / equipment capability
tooling_equipment_capability.value: Steel conduit shot blasting and fiberglass filament winding, with proprietary CAD for pipe stress, heat transfer, and soil loading.

end_market_qualifications.label: End-market qualifications
end_market_qualifications.value: ISO-certified quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management. Manufacturing facilities adhere to ASTM, NACE, CSA, and EN standards.
